_comment: chartCost vectors (UI reviews R2 and N2, review 5): 'refused' must be TOO_COSTLY at the stated path, through chartCost and validateBlock alike; 'accepted' must pass both. To keep the file small, a data.values of {"$rows": n, "$extra": {...}} stands for n rows {i, v: (i * 7919) % 1000, ...extra}, i from 0, and {"$rows": n, "$shape": "iabc"} for n rows {i, a: i, b: n - 1 - i, c: i % 7}; expand it before checking. The report gives each accepted spec's measured time with Vega 6.4.0 / Vega-Lite 6.5.0.

refused.name: an area split by a window-written detail: 500 paths x 500 x values imputed (1.2 s; 2,000 rows: 18.9 s)
lines split by a window-written detail in 2 x 6 views: 24,000 paths (1.5 s)
a ci0 in a layer's shared encoding, grouped by a window-written x, is costed in each view
review 6 overwriteChain19: a window renames c, then 19 ci aggregates by c (24.6 s)
review 6 overwriteChain5 (6.2 s)
review 6 overwriteAgg1: one ci aggregate by a window-written c (1.3 s)
review 6 binnedCi: a binned channel grouped by its 5,000 values with ci aggregates (1.3 s)
review 6 overwriteMarks64: a window renames c, 64 point views over it (320,000 marks, 2.5 s)
review 5 aggCiChain: twenty chained ci aggregates over 5,000 groups (24.8 s)
review 5 aggCi20: one aggregate of 8 ci ops over 4 fields, by i (1.8 s)
review 5 encCiTooltip: a ci channel aggregate and six ci tooltips (1.3 s)
review 5 errorbandCi8: eight errorband/errorbar layers with extent ci (1.7 s)
review 5 errorbandCi1: one errorband with extent ci over 5,000 x values (0.5 s)
3,000 points with tooltips in 5 layers: within the mark cap, over the budget
UI re-review N2: distinct, frame [-2500, null], 5,000 rows
UI re-review N2: four distinct windows of that kind
UI re-review N2: fold of 50 fields over 100 rows, then distinct over +-1249
UI re-review N2: vconcat 2 x layer 8 points with tooltips over 5,000 rows
min over a frame open at its end, 5,000 rows
min over +-110 after a fold that doubles 2,400 rows (unfolded it would pass)
16 line views over 5,000 rows: the whole estimate over budget

accepted.name: two measures folded over 2,500 rows, a line per measure (the fold's key has 2 values)
an area stacked by a fold of 3 measures over 1,500 rows
review 5 honestBarLabels: 5,000 rows summed into 7 bars with labels
an errorband with extent ci by 7 categories over 5,000 rows
ci0, ci1, median and q1 over the whole partition of 5,000 rows, drawn as a line
5,000 points in 2 layers, a cumulative sum and a running max
slowest measured: 5,000 bars on a band scale (one band per row)
twenty incremental windows over 5,000 rows, drawn as a line
min over +-99 on 5,000 rows, drawn as a line
